name: Summit AZ - Water Pressure City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-26

# Summary
Rewrite drafts for the Phoenix and Scottsdale water pressure pages, both city-swap copies. Applied live Sep 25 and 26 per the handoff. Phoenix was later retargeted (Oct 7) to "PRV replacement Phoenix".

# Pages
| City | ID | Draft file | Before | Main keyword |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phoenix | 10283 | `Summit-AZ-Water-Pressure-Phoenix-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | Discovered not indexed; 67% same as Scottsdale | water pressure repair (176 / KD 26), plus prv replacement (522 / 19), how to fix low water pressure in house (633 / 23), high water pressure in house (265 / 26) |
| Scottsdale | 10286 | `Summit-AZ-Water-Pressure-Scottsdale-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | 92% same as Mesa; never said "low water pressure" or explained the PRV | water pressure repair (170 / KD 26), low water pressure (3,600 / KD 42, exception), PRV replacement carried over |

# Local facts used
- Phoenix (phoenix.gov): normal range 40 to 100 psi, above 80 psi needs owner action, the city owns street to meter and the homeowner owns everything after, including the PRV.
- Scottsdale: elevation-driven 40 to 120 psi range, the 1995 PRV rule, 2025 hardness figures.

# Fixes
- Three identical "Testing & Diagnostics" boxes replaced with distinct ones (Pressure Testing, PRV Replacement, Scale & Pipe Checks).
- "Same-day water pressure service" FAQ replaced; a typo removed; empty photo alt proposed.

# Decisions and status
- Oct 7 boost: Phoenix H1, subheading, intro, focus keyword, title and meta moved to "PRV replacement Phoenix" (480 / KD 19, Kim approved), plus new inbound links.
